notes.en: The network's machine-checkable contract with the agent. Each assertion is measured against the LIVE site, never against the repo. No claim without measurement. R64: the ledger_integrity kind born in the operator-contract repair - the book that defines what was asked vs delivered now proves itself (evidence per delivery + bridgehead agreement); the Console-era backlog R22-R61 was retroactively ledgered with sources.
notes.he: החוזה הנבדק-מכונה של הרשת עם הסוכן. כל טענה נמדדת מול האתר החי, לעולם לא מול הריפו. שום טענה בלי מדידה.

desc.en: R46 treasury ratchet (monotonic lifetime accrual): treasuryProfitEverMu never drops. The working balance (treasuryProfit) is fuel-consumed by design (economy drains it for ladder/gas), so the ratchet moved to the true monotonic counter (seeded with the git-proven historical high-water 213752mu, commit 4ac9369, 2026-09-17). Floor only ever moves upward.
